sourceGenerations.prompt: TrackType: SFX, Intimate close dry small woodfire steadily consuming a loose pile of slender branches, woody sticks and papery dead leaves. Countless quiet overlapping twig snaps and rounded woody ticks form a thick tactile continuous crackle with audible warm middle-frequency wood body, softly crumpling leaf texture and a low gentle flame rush. Natural irregular small details throughout, restrained even intensity in flat open outdoor acoustics. Length: 30 seconds.

processing: Mix two genuine independently generated float takes: take1 seconds6–24 at unity, with 150Hz two-pole high-pass/6500Hz two-pole low-pass and +3dB 900Hz two-octave equalizer; take2 seconds4–22 at linear gain0.65, with350Hz two-pole high-pass/5200Hz two-pole low-pass. No mix normalization. Soft compressor threshold0.007/ratio3.5/attack0.12ms/release60ms/knee2.8/makeup1 restrains isolated snaps. Five-millisecond boundary click guards; fixed gain toward-27.5dBFS RMS constrained to conservative peak headroom. Stereo44.1kHz160kbps desktop MP3 and mono44.1kHz96kbps mobile MP3 encoded independently from processed float. Raw masters retained unchanged. No external recording, synthesized noise, reverb, delay, or speed/pitch change.
